SCIENCE ADVENTURE 2 · CLASS 31

Penguin’s Weather Lab

Age 4–5 YearsClass 31 · ScienceSkill Weather and what we wear

Sunny, rainy, snowy — match each kind of weather to the clothes that fit it.

Play the science game ↓Print the worksheet ↓Play with a finger, a stylus or a mouse. Instructions are spoken aloud.
PLAY · WEATHER AND WHAT WE WEAR

Penguin’s Weather Lab

Look at each weather picture, then tap the clothes that match it. What do we wear on a sunny day?

Tap a weather picture, then tap the clothes that match it.

Weather-ready!

Sun hat for sunshine, raincoat for rain, warm coat for snow — Penguin is dressed for anything.

FOR GROWN-UPS

Why this adventure helps.

Weather-to-clothes matching builds observation plus self-care talk: ask what YOUR child wears on a rainy day, and why umbrellas do not help much in snow.

Prefer paper? The Penguin’s Weather Lab worksheet prints the same experiment with room to think and draw — and a grown-up answer line. Printing never marks anything complete.
